assessment.a_distinct_from_ready_and_paused: PASS (specialist visual judgment at 1x and 3x, colour and grayscale, on #172336). Cell 0 is three disconnected segments (9, 8 and 15 px) placed top, right and bottom-left around an empty centre - a broken ring. Ready is one continuous diagonal check with asymmetric arms (29 px, one component). Paused is two solid vertical 3x10 bars (two 30-px components). At 1x the held cell reads as a small broken circle, Ready as a check, Paused as two bars; none of the three can be confused by silhouette. Grayscale changes nothing structural.
assessment.b_distinct_from_retry_and_start: PASS with a caveat (inference, not an owner line: BRIEF line 3/7 non-colour distinction read over the view's status set, idle -> Start through both consumers). Start is a solid filled right-pointing triangle - unmistakable. Retry is the closest neighbour: a heavier near-closed ring (54 px, one component) with an arrowhead at top-right and a 1-px inner notch. The held cell differs by structure (three gaps of 2-3 px, wide empty centre, no arrowhead, roughly half the mass). At 3x the pair is clearly distinct; at 1x grayscale the difference is visible but subtle (ring with notch vs ring with three gaps). The caller's visual review should look at this pair specifically on the fixture capture.
assessment.c_reads_as_ongoing_work_when_frozen: QUALIFIED. A frozen spinner cell is the conventional static 'busy / in progress' idiom and does not read as success or pause - the owner requirements that actually bind (PLAR line 422; BRIEF line 3). Honestly: frozen, it does not convey motion, and a user who does not know the preference is active could read it as stalled. Mitigations present in the consumer: the text label 'Working' is rendered beside the glyph in both consumers (view.mjs line 62), and the held cell is literally a phase of the loop, so identity is preserved when the preference switches. No source requires the stationary symbol to convey motion; this criterion set binds non-success/non-pause reading plus distinction, and records the 'stalled' reading as a known limit.

alternatives.assessment: Equivalent by construction: each is a clockwise quarter-turn of cell 0 with the same three components and 32 px. No readability gain. Cell 0 is preferred because it is byte-equal (alpha + visible RGBA) to the accepted seed, so the stationary symbol has the cleanest provenance, and `still: 0` matches the caller's successor default.

alternatives.option: P2 - new static three-dot ellipsis glyph (r2 reduced_motion.d)
alternatives.assessment: Conventional 'in progress' glyph and clearly distinct from check/bars/ring/triangle, but it needs new 16x16 art, a new descriptor path or key, and breaks the identity between the animated and stationary forms (switching the preference would swap symbols, not just stop motion). At 1x, three 2x2 dots risk reading as a dashed line. Not recommended for this successor; viable fallback if the owner rejects frozen-spinner semantics.
Too close to the delivered Retry ring (a ring minus its arrowhead); would weaken the Retry distinction. Not recommended.
Not recommended: motion preference is presentation, not a backend transition; the successor correctly keeps src/queue.ts unchanged.
